stem:
Felicia started placing square tiles inside a rectangle, as shown in the diagram. Each square tile has a side length of 1 cm.

She continued placing square tiles without any overlaps to cover the rectangle. What is the area of the rectangle in square centimeters?
instruction: Record your answer and fill in the bubbles on your answer document. Be sure to use the correct place value.
visual_elements: diagram of a rectangle partially covered with square tiles; the rectangle is 3 tiles high and 7 tiles wide; each tile is 1 cm by 1 cm
difficulty_rationale: Requires interpretation of the diagram to find the length and height of the rectangle and then to compute the area by multiplying length by height.
